column1: # Hospitals took 34% of private health insurance spending in 2024, the largest share.
# Source: CMS National Health Expenditure Accounts, Table 4, 2024: $1645 billion of private health insurance spending. "Insurer overhead and profit" is CMS's net cost of health insurance.

column3: Physicians and clinics: $505 billion, 30.7% of $1645 billion
Insurer overhead and profit: $176 billion, 10.7% of $1645 billion
